entry.title: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok's ‘For You' feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful ‘rabbit holes' effect
entry.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 06 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect' of its recommender system.
